decisions.reason: The Demeter yogurt range is a publicly announced flagship that extends an established line and fits the firm's biodynamic, sustainability-oriented direction, so the firm's investment and visible commitment make keeping it very likely.

The mild sliced cheese is close to the core in-house cheesemaking business, was recently launched with its own product page, and any weak early sales can still be put down to the market ramp-up, so the firm will keep it.

The sliced butter cheese uses existing cheesemaking capabilities and shelf relationships and has a dedicated web presence, so dropping it after just one year is unlikely, though it is less central than the flagship range.
